lines.text: AA Decision Index v2: decision models top out at 73; Haiku 5.5 Max 77 and GPT-6 Luna Max 76
Meta ships Wonder-trained Muse and Meta AI models with Active Memory and Active Focus
Sapiens AI's Agnes 2.5 Pro Theta scores 24 on AA Intelligence Index at $0.10/$0.30

feed.headline: AA Decision Index v2: decision models top out at 73; Haiku 5.5 Max 77
feed.why: Drex Max and GLiDE tie at 73, Mammoth 72. Language models score higher but cost far more per task (Luna Max 76).

feed.headline: Meta rolls Wonder-trained models into Muse and Meta AI
feed.why: Meta's own eval: Active Memory 90% vs 76% on using critical context. Muse Spaces shipped the same day.

feed.headline: Sapiens AI's Agnes 2.5 Pro Theta scores 24 on AA Intelligence Index
feed.why: Proprietary, 1M context, $0.10/$0.30 per 1M tokens. Released Nov 7; no lab launch post found.

feed.headline: Nous drops Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B
feed.why: Post-trained to cut propaganda-style answers (lab: 22% to about 1%). No AA Index score yet.

feed.headline: OpenAI partners with Hacktron and widens its Daybreak Red access
feed.why: Joint testing of how OpenAI systems touch third-party services, alongside higher bug bounties.

feed.headline: FT: Anthropic bought ~$3.4B of gas generators, about 1.7 GW, from OnePWR
feed.why: Commitments from late September per FT. Anthropic and OnePWR did not comment.

feed.headline: xAI turns on default Grok API text watermarking
feed.why: Listed grok-4.x models from Nov 7. Admins can opt out per model; check the x-watermark header.

feed.headline: OpenAI reportedly closes ~$11B tranche at ~$1.25T valuation
feed.why: Bloomberg via TechCrunch. Full round may reach about $20B. OpenAI had not commented.

feed.headline: Anthropic publishes agent-memory research on notes and dreaming
feed.why: How agents keep notes in session and consolidate memory offline, with Managed Agents case studies.
